scope: Independent read-only source/metadata review, including final bounded-admission and deletion delta. No CLI/model/test import or Git command was executed by reviewer.
checked: Fixed Git argv via shell=False; hooks disabled; no job/source/patch execution, model launcher, scheduler, arbitrary shell payload or main/force/dispatch push path. Claims/results write only their declared research refs.
Immutable job bytes pinned to exact dispatch commit and SHA; source_refs path/SHA verified. Current path history rejects mutation and targeted deletion history rejects removal before enumeration.

Claim commit exact parent=dispatch; normal push to absent per-job ref makes concurrent distinct sibling claims non-fast-forward competitors. Readback checks ref. Same declared owner resumes exact old claim/deadline; other owner/reclaim/expiry/reset not implemented.

Bounded claims require completed source_only dependency from same worker, exact primary-published approval source_ref path/SHA, dependency result commit+worker identity and requested caps within approved/global caps. All dependencies completed.

Results are write-once normal-push children of exact claim, bind immutable job/claim bytes, worker and hashes; collect revalidates exact parent and payload. Failure/timeout/blocked metrics null with first_error, secondary errors retained; finite scalar reported metrics and original clock/caps validated.

Completed artifact names exactly equal expected_outputs; failure subset only; declared/actual casefold collisions rejected. Flat UTF8 source/patch/text/JSON only, regular file mode, bounded bytes/counts, traversal/binary/symlink/credential/private-path/common data/prediction/weight-name filters.

Collected metrics/resources/clocks remain remote_reported_requires_independent_verification and promotion=false. No remote connection, actual worker execution or ML improvement inferred from source readiness.

13 prepared offline bare-Git test methods cover race, roundtrip, owner/resume, immutable mutation/deletion/result, bad bindings/hashes, caps/null clock, sanitized outputs, symlink modes and same-worker primary approval. Test source inspected, not executed.

resolved_findings.resolution: Exact successful set / failed subset enforced at submit and collect.

resolved_findings.resolution: Entry/type guards added before schema set checks; malformed JSON subcases prepared.

resolved_findings.issue: Removed current-tree job escaped per-path history and unfinished-worker enumeration.
resolved_findings.resolution: Targeted historical deletion guard precedes enumeration; existing immutable-job test adds actual deletion case.

limitations: This is a trusted Git collaboration protocol, not a security sandbox: source/text filters cannot prove semantic absence of disguised raw rows, predictions, weights or every credential. Root/manual review remains mandatory; returned code is never automatically applied/imported.
Ownership atomicity is per job ref. One existing caller per worker is a cooperative operational rule; no distributed worker-wide mutex between different concurrent job IDs is claimed.

Git result records pre-push submitted timestamp; actual publication latency and remote host wall/RSS/ML metrics are not independently certified. Root must retain late/unknown evidence and independently verify/local-confirm before qualification.

Transport preparation/status is separate from immutable ready jobs. Publish each final READY job once only after root actual offline-check PASS/closure. Do not mutate draft to ready under an already published job ID.
No actual remote claim/connection or execution was observed by this reviewer. Local offline fixtures cannot establish real cross-computer transport or model correctness.
root_next_step: Run exact13 offline tests sequentially under the root-owned180s guard, retain actual exit/cleanup/source hashes, then publish READY only on actual PASS. No reviewer execution authorization or quality promotion is implied.
